title: A type inside a class
description:
A type that only makes sense together with a class can live inside it.

Write a class `Player` with a nested `enum class State { idle, running, jumping };` and:

- `State state() const` (a new player is `idle`),
- `void run()`: becomes `running`,
- `void jump()`: becomes `jumping`, but only if currently `running` (you cannot jump from standing still),
- `void stop()`: becomes `idle`.

From outside, the enum is written `Player::State::running`.
lessonTitle: Classes in Header Files and Nested Types
